description: Work out how many credits a submission will cost and whether the balance covers it. Nothing is submitted and no credits are spent. Send the URLs (best: invalid and duplicate URLs are counted exactly) or just url_count. Call this before submit_urls and show the result to the user.

type.description: "normal" costs 1 credit per URL. "instant" is priority indexing: 10 credits per URL, sent first, for important pages. It does not make indexing instant. Call it "priority" when you talk to the user. Priority needs at least one credit purchase.

url_count.description: Number of URLs, if you don't want to send the list.

urls.description: The URLs you plan to submit. Use this or url_count.

name: estimate_cost
title: Estimate the credit cost
